disposition_reason: The author release contains ordered rare/common-context decoding analyses, but the published Figure 3C/3G score vectors, exact source partitions and animal-to-session mapping are not recovered. The existing 17-session fixed-reference probability reconstruction is explicitly calibrated to locally declared conventions and cannot stand in for the paper baseline. Both perturbation panels in the registered target must remain in scope.

source_paper.title: Control of representation updating by higher-order thalamus enables history-based decision-making

evidence.locator: Version 0; manuscript summary; Figure 3.zip file entry, md5 a09182a53e67bb97f0edcb5fc7e7d02f
evidence.supports: Authentic figure-specific analysis/data release; Figure 3 archive is 327.3 MB and was not downloaded in this review.
Defines rare/common block decoding, brain-area inputs, 70/30 trial partition, 17 Figure 3C and 20 Figure 3G sessions, and author R entrypoints.
Registration includes PUL suppression and TRN activation. Its blocked/session-held-out proposal changes the source task.

evidence.locator: Declared reconstruction conventions 1–7 and primary-document caveat
evidence.supports: Local seed101/caret/xgboost conventions are not a recovered author result; source/public labels are exposed and animal mapping is unresolved.
34-cell mean probability discrepancy measures reproduction. Published P = .008 is never a performance target, and exact historical AUC values are unknown.

target.description: Decode whether an identical tone occurs in a rare or common block from population neural activity, separately with/without PUL suppression (Figure 3C) and TRN activation (Figure 3G); retain both registered perturbation panels.

dataset.description: Author Zenodo record 19465617 Version 0, Figure3.zip; Figure3C_data.RData with Figure3C_analysis.R and Figure3G_data.RData with Figure3G_analysis.R. Release identity is verified, not the contents of the undownloaded archive.

cohort.description: Author legend reports 17 sessions/four animals in 3C and 20 sessions/four animals in 3G. The exact animal/session join and TableS1 discrepancy documented by the existing implementation remain unreconciled; 17 sessions cannot be treated as17 independent animals.

split.description: Original models train on 70% of trials and evaluate the held 30%, separately per condition. Exact paper draws and tuning details are not recovered; the local deterministic seed101 partition is a reconstruction convention. Temporal/session/animal holdout is a separate extension.

inputs.description: Preprocessed/binned neural firing: PPC activity only for 3C; PPC and PUL activity for 3G, across the six tones and original laser conditions. Labels, tone identity and session metadata define support and must not become extra decoder predictors.

preprocessing.description: The author README identifies binned firing data and source scripts; complete upstream bin/window construction and exact Figure3G subsampling are not frozen. The local workspace pivot, zero-fill and feature order conventions have not established all upstream paper preprocessing.

metric.description: Recover the original per-condition ROC-AUC calculation, class direction and source aggregation from the exact author runs before selecting a primary predictive score. The local implementation distinguishes source-auto pROC orientation from fixed Randomised-positive AUC; probability-MAE agreement and perturbation p-values are calibration/descriptive outputs.

aggregation.description: Retain every original session and both laser conditions within each panel, with panel results separate. The author legend plots one point per recording session; a combined paper-performance scalar and biologically valid independent-unit weighting have not been recovered. The local 34-cell average covers3C reconstruction only.

comparison.primary_metric: Original Figure3C/3G context-decoding ROC-AUC, pending exact author metric and aggregation recovery

published_baseline.description: No exact paper AUC vectors or aggregate score recovered. The Figure3C P = .008 annotation is not predictive performance and is not a baseline.

reproduced_author_baseline.description: Author README provides3C and3G entrypoints, but no admitted faithful rerun. The fixed17-session reference uses declared local conventions and only establishes a reconstruction comparator.

minimum_effect.rationale: A meaningful AUC gain must be justified for this context-decoding endpoint after original score variability and complete cohort are recovered; no margin or stronger significance is substituted.

uncertainty.method: Predeclare a paired candidate-versus-author comparison on identical source test support after animal mapping; model resamples and trials remain nested, with a small-animal-sample procedure justified before evaluation.
uncertainty.independent_unit: Mouse; original session-to-mouse mapping unresolved, with repeated sessions nested within mouse.
uncertainty.rationale: The published session comparison tests a perturbation effect, not whether one decoder improves on another; overlapping trials and sessions cannot supply independent biological replication.

paper_win_requires: Recover the published numeric baseline and reconcile author preprocessing, class orientation, original partitions and source population for both 3C and3G.
Freeze candidate and author-reproduction recipes before final evaluation on the same original support and allowed neural inputs.
Exceed the faithful author decoder by a justified effect with valid paired uncertainty; reproduce the perturbation contrasts without using a larger contrast or smaller p-value as the win.
Retain all original sessions and both conditions; do not claim whole-paper improvement from the existing3C-only probability reconstruction.
Label temporally blocked, session-held-out or animal-held-out decoding as an extension, even if it improves over a rerun author algorithm on that new split.

current_sota.description: No separately verified current-SOTA comparison; the source-author and local reconstruction baselines remain distinct.

episode.improvement_loop: Inactive until source recovery. A future episode may iterate only on declared development feedback inside the original training portion, keeping the same source task and exposing neither protected test labels nor reference probabilities.
episode.candidate_freeze: Commit the complete method, feature/access policy, preprocessing, tuning and seed policy before a single owner-controlled final comparison; no adaptive feedback between sessions.
episode.final_evaluation: Use the recovered original 3C and3G supports and source metric. Report all condition/session results and candidate-minus-author differences. Existing artifact grading remains a separate calibration outcome.
episode.baseline_policy: Recover and independently audit author scripts and numeric paper outputs; retain any source defects and local repairs as declared provenance. A repaired/new-split baseline must not silently replace the original paper result.

blocking_issues: Published3C/3G metric values and exact author train/test/tuning recipe are unrecovered.
Animal/session mapping and recorded Figure3C annotation discrepancy remain unresolved.
Upstream firing feature construction, Figure3G subsampling and complete source support are not bound to an evaluator.
Fixed concrete iteration/access/compute budgets, meaningful effect, biological uncertainty rule and protected same-task evaluator are not admitted.
Existing exposed-label probability reconstruction cannot establish predictive superiority.

legacy.notes: Preserve the 17-session34-cell fixed-reference grader and historical probability-MAE results unchanged. They measure reconstruction of explicit local conventions; neither near-zero discrepancy nor a copied-label AUC establishes a paper win.
